note: Census of the product families (plan file 29 §4.4, package C0c): the event types the reducer switches on, read from its source at run time, and the waivers, each with its reason. Exports are read from the modules when the recorder loads them; nothing here lists them, so deleting an export needs no edit here unless a waiver names it (a waiver of something that no longer exists fails the census).

excludedFiles.reason: under the recorder's mock-module layer alone its 17 mounted tests take 282 s instead of 16 s and 14 time out (every call of the modules it mocks, made on each render, is snapshotted as test context): not harmless, so it is not recorded; its only family use is optimistic's applyOptimisticAdd and applyOptimisticRemove, which sync tests also exercise (C0c report, finding 2)

noFrame.reason: sync-context.tsx hands the entry itself to a promise, scopedClient.session.messages(...).then(unwrapMessageRecordsResult), where it materializes a session and where it reconnects, so the job that calls it has no frame; a test that does the same is not told apart (docs/TESTING.md)
